translations.web: There is no one like you, Yahweh. You are great, and your name is great in might.
translations.bsb: There is none like You, O LORD. You are great, and Your name is mighty in power.
translations.kjv: Forasmuch as there is none like unto thee, O LORD; thou art great, and thy name is great in might.
translations.asv: There is none like unto thee, O Jehovah; thou art great, and thy name is great in might.
